note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated outbound customs records to UAE (Jebel Ali) and Qatar (Port Hamad) with HS 08104000 (fresh blueberries) and B/L numbers 1095401, 9981654, 9817333, 9726684, latest 2026-02-27; the company also appears as importer of fresh avocado (HS 08044000) from Tanzania, i.e. it is an active fresh-fruit trader, not a manufacturer. Declared HS 080810 (fresh apples) is NOT the HS on the observed outbound rows (08104000 blueberries); per project rule this is not a rejection ground - company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 08104000 (with 08044000 also present on inbound). Role: trader. No revenue or export-volume figures are stated because none were published; do not infer them from the 132-record count.
